newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Halim Saad says holds 53.2 pct of Intria.
newsitem.headline: Halim Saad says holds 53.2 pct of Intria.

text.p: Prominent Malaysian businessman Halim Saad said he holds a 53.2 percent equity stake in infrastructure developer Intria Bhd.
In a disclosure of shareholdings to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Monday, Halim said he has 155.04 million Intria shares held by DCB Merchant Nominees (Tempatan) Sdn Bhd.
Intria, formerly Acidchem (Malaysia) Bhd, has total outstanding shares amounting to 291.55 million.

Halim, also executive chairman of infrastructure conglomerate Renong Bhd, made the disclosure to the exchange after disposing of two blocks of Intria stock totalling 12.28 million shares on September 5.
